<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1584312_lms.LMSUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>LMSUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var LMSUtils = Class.create();
LMSUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },
	refQualSchedule: function(){
		var schedulesNotToShow = [];
		var grEnroll = new GlideRecord("x_1584312_lms_enrollment");
		grEnroll.addEncodedQuery("opened_byDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe");
		grEnroll.query();
		while(grEnroll.next()){
			schedulesNotToShow.push(grEnroll.training_schedule.sys_id.toString());
		}

		//Curso feito 3 vezes
		var gaEnroll = new GlideAggregate("x_1584312_lms_enrollment");
        gaEnroll.addAggregate('COUNT', 'training_schedule');
		gs.info("addAggergate" + gaEnroll.addAggregate('COUNT', 'training_schedule'));
        gaEnroll.addEncodedQuery("opened_byDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe");
        gaEnroll.addQuery('state', 'IN', '1,8,3');
        gaEnroll.groupBy('training_schedule');
        gaEnroll.query();
        while (gaEnroll.next()) {
            var count = gaEnroll.getAggregate('COUNT', 'training_schedule');
			gs.info("getAggergate" + gaEnroll.getAggregate('COUNT', 'training_schedule'));
            if (count >= 3) {
				gs.info("Schedules IDs:"+gaEnroll.training_schedule.sys_id.toString());
                schedulesNotToShow.push(gaEnroll.training_schedule.sys_id.toString());
            }
        }
		
		var schedulesToShow = [];
		var grSchedule = new GlideRecord("x_1584312_lms_training_schedule");
		grSchedule.addEncodedQuery("date>" + gs.endOfToday() + "^instructor!=" + gs.getUserID());
		grSchedule.query();
		while(grSchedule.next()){
			var grTotalEnrolls = new GlideRecord("x_1584312_lms_enrollment");
			grTotalEnrolls.addEncodedQuery("training_schedule=" + grSchedule.sys_id.toString() + "^stateIN1,8,3");
			grTotalEnrolls.query();
			var countTotalEnrolls = 0;
			while (grTotalEnrolls.next()) {
				countTotalEnrolls++;  
			}		
			if(schedulesNotToShow.indexOf(grSchedule.sys_id.toString()) == -1 && grSchedule.spots > countTotalEnrolls){
				schedulesToShow.push(grSchedule.sys_id.toString());
			}
		}
		
		return "sys_idIN" + schedulesToShow.join(",");

	},

    type: 'LMSUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-01-30 17:17:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>7006552b8357121037bab6cfeeaad37b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LMSUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="LMS" source="x_1584312_lms">fdb252aa8393121037bab6cfeeaad3d7</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="LMS">fdb252aa8393121037bab6cfeeaad3d7</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_7006552b8357121037bab6cfeeaad37b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-01-30 17:17:25</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
